questions.question: Why did thousands of armed men from the tribes of Israel come to David at Hebron?

answers.text: To turn Saul's kingdom over to him
To win back the town of Ziklag

questions.question: When men from Benjamin and Judah came to David's stronghold, what did David want to know?

answers.text: Whether they came in peace or to betray him
Whether they had fought the Philistines before
Whether they knew where Saul was hiding

questions.question: As men kept coming to David day after day, his army grew to be like which army?
When armed men gathered at Hebron to make David king, the rest of the Israelites were divided about it. True or false?
